title: Earthquakes
quote: Magnitude = energy at the focus; intensity = effect at a place

boxes.title: Basics
items: **Focus** (hypocentre): rupture point inside Earth; **epicentre**: point above it, strongest shaking
**Seismic doublet**: two independent quakes of similar size; e.g. ==**Venezuela** M 7.1 & 7.5== (589 dead)
Continental mantle quakes **80+ km** below Moho (Stanford map)

items: ==**AP has no Zone V area**== (APPSC 2024); AP in Zones II-III
